params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the content which forms root of the page tree, to be deleted.

items.docs: This API operation permanently deletes an entire page tree in Atlassian Confluence, starting from the specified page ID and including all of its child pages and descendants. When executed via a DELETE request to the endpoint, it removes not just the target page but cascades the deletion through the complete hierarchical structure beneath it, making it a powerful but potentially destructive operation that should be used with caution. The operation requires appropriate permissions and the page ID
